editorial_review.method: second-pass AI comparison of French text with classic chapter projection; modern packet used to identify source of selected discrepancies; not independent human certification

French-only peace offering terminology correction in Gen.31.
Keep intentionally quoted English term in Lev.2.
editorial_review.status: cohort reviewed; corrected text still subject to full-corpus and independent validation

technical_screening.method: literal ordered tag/attribute equality and nonempty text segment count comparison against pinned modern packet; targeted literal replacements retain tags and counts; not full XML/OSIS schema validation
observations: Manuscript tree contains all 1,189 chapter files before and after; 88 files changed within cohort.
Existing reference corrections and source annotations retained.
Introduction titles still contain English-modern candidate wording (Num.1, Deut.1, Josh.1); defer to global metadata inventory.

editorial_review.method: second-pass AI comparison of French chapter text to classic chapter projection; modern OSIS packets used for structural checks and selected editorial discrepancies, not a systematic three-way semantic audit or independent certification
decisions: Restore original theological assertions, including divine wrath and curse, atoning satisfaction, election, sanctification, perseverance, and eternal consequences; do not harmonize Henry to a modern doctrinal preference.

Restore historical formulations in context, while retaining explicit historical limitations in Num.31, Deut.7, Deut.20 and Josh.8; modern editorial disclaimers deferred for consistent corpus-wide review.
Restore omitted applications and arguments in Josh.13 within existing paragraphs.
Potential corruption or lacuna in classic projection at Deut.32 (negation) and Josh.9 (broken sentences) retained for source verification; do not invent missing wording.
editorial_review.status: cohort reviewed and corrected; pending independent editorial validation and full-corpus technical validation

remaining_release_checks: Verify actual source masters and complete source inventory including introductions.
Normalize inconsistent candidate language/status in introduction titles (e.g. Exod.1, Lev.1), as part of global metadata inventory.
Resolve earlier discrepancy queues and review English QA issue #596 separately.
Independent editorial validation, full OSIS/reference/typography validation, native SWORD compilation and readback, rights, release authorization.
